messages:
Ana Romero: ptal on PR #842 — addressed the retry/backoff comments and added a short smoke script. CI currently green but e2e flaky on one test.
Matt Chen: thanks, will review this afternoon. quick q: did you update the changelog section for the behavior change?
Ana Romero: yes — added a short note under `behavior.md` and linked it in the PR description. also included a perf table from a quick local run.
Sophie Patel: nice. can you paste the smoke command? want to run it in staging before merge.
Ana Romero: sure — `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --filter=retry_tests --env=staging`
Jordan Lee: saw that. left one tiny nit about changing `logger.debug` -> `logger.info` for the retry attempts (too noisy today). otherwise LGTM.
Matt Chen: left an approval. Jordan, can you drop a comment on the nit so Ana can address, or should I just merge and follow up in a patch?
Jordan Lee: i'll comment now so it's explicit. low risk, but prefer the log change first.
Ana Romero: fixed the log level and pushed a small commit (squash on merge). added smoke run output to the PR description: short table + median latency.
ci-bot: build status: ✅ all checks passed for branch redwood/retry-fix (#842) — build 3281
Sophie Patel: ran the smoke in staging, no regressions on the paths I checked.
Matt Chen: OK — i'm planning to merge at 17:00 PST when the merge window opens. can someone be merge custodian?
Ana Romero: i can take custodian for the merge window. i'll be at my desk until 18:00.
Sophie Patel: i'm OOO after 16:00, so i can't.
Jordan Lee: if anything goes sideways after merge, i'll be on-call tonight starting 19:00 — ping me in #eng-oncall.
Matt Chen: perfect. Ana, merge when ready and set the canary flag. also please include the smoke command in the release notes.
Ana Romero: will do. thanks all :thumbsup: 
Matt Chen: one more tiny ask — add a one-line rollback note in the PR description (why reverting is safe).
Ana Romero: added it. PTAL again if you want; otherwise i'll merge at 17:00.
Jordan Lee: no more comments from me.
Matt Chen: all good from me.
Ana Romero: merging now — will post canary update shortly.
ci-bot: merge performed by Ana Romero on branch redwood/retry-fix (#842) — canary scheduled
Ana Romero: canary started — routing 5% traffic for 10 minutes. monitoring dash: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/842
Sophie Patel: saw the canary metrics, looks stable so far.
Ana Romero: canary passed, gradually ramping to 100%. thanks everyone for quick eyes.
Matt Chen: thanks! :rocket:
